fact: A national cybersecurity reference framework for AI systems, presented by ASIN on 2026-10-08, sets four risk tiers from minimal to unacceptable with controls, an AI officer and ethics committee, and filtering and human validation for generative AI against manipulated content; it is reported as presented, not adopted.
system: référentiel national de cybersécurité des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle

fact: La Nation states that article 576 of the Code du numerique provides five years' imprisonment and a FCFA 25 million fine for publishing online, without consent, a montage of a person's image or words whose artificial character is not evident or flagged.
La Nation reports that a learner prosecuted for circulating retouched photographs of his teacher was heard by the CRIET on 8 October 2026.
